title: My working day
instructions: Hemşire David bir iş gününü anlatıyor. Saatlere ve sıklık bildiren kelimelere dikkat et.

script.speaker: david
script.text: I'm David, and I'm a nurse in a big hospital.

script.speaker: david
script.text: I usually get up at half past five, because my work starts at seven.

script.speaker: david
script.text: I never have a big breakfast. I just drink a cup of coffee.

script.speaker: david
script.text: I go to work by bike. It takes twenty minutes.

script.speaker: david
script.text: My job is hard, but I love helping people.

script.speaker: david
script.text: I finish work at three and I often go to the gym after that.

script.speaker: david
script.text: In the evening, I cook dinner and watch TV. I go to bed early, at ten.

questions.prompt: What time does David's work start?
questions.feedback: İşi yedide (at seven) başlıyor. Beş buçuk kalkış saati.

questions.prompt: How does David go to work?
questions.feedback: İşe bisikletle (by bike) gidiyor; yirmi dakika sürüyor.
questions.evidence: I go to work by bike.

questions.prompt: What does David often do after work?
questions.feedback: İşten sonra sık sık (often) spor salonuna gidiyor.
questions.evidence: I often go to the gym after that.
